06The practiceAudio engineering · Production programming

Engineering

Steve Peele II is a professional audio engineer and production programmer.

His universe is the whole live production ecosystem, held and operated as one connected system. The competencies are the work itself: house audio engineering, IEM and playback systems, live production design, deployable rig engineering, touring deployment and production programming.

He can be engaged to manage one facet or several, a monitor mix, FOH, playback, a build, production design, with mastery in each facet and in how they connect.

My universe

Live
Input Console IEM Playback House
House L
House R

Every layer expands from the same system: source and console, monitoring and playback, the room and its coverage. The discipline is the focus, not the tool. What is built is built to deploy, to hold under show conditions, and to serve the music in the room.
